gbm_population_evidence.quote: Participants with histologically confirmed diagnosis of surgically accessible recurrent/progressive glioblastoma will be enrolled in this study

candidate_evidence.quote: Beginning 14 days prior to scheduled surgery, patients receive pembrolizumab IV over 30 minutes.
GROUP B: Beginning 14 days prior to scheduled surgery, patients receive placebo IV.

combination_partners: autologous tumor lysate-pulsed dendritic cell vaccine (ATL-DC)

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: I. To evaluate the influence of pembrolizumab on the cell cycle-related genetic signature within the tumor microenvironment of progressive/recurrent glioblastoma.

role_evidence.quote: Beginning 14 days prior to scheduled surgery, patients receive pembrolizumab IV over 30 minutes.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Immunotherapy with monoclonal antibodies, such as pembrolizumab, may help the body's immune system attack the cancer

agents.agent_name_registered: Dendritic Cell Tumor Cell Lysate Vaccine
agents.active_moiety: dendritic cell tumor cell lysate vaccine

role_evidence.quote: Dendritic Cell Tumor Cell Lysate Vaccine (other names: DC tumor cell lysate vaccine, dendritic cell-pulsed tumor cell lysate vaccine): Given ID

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous tumor lysate-pulsed dendritic cell vaccine (ATL-DC)

role_evidence.quote: Patients also receive ATL-DC ID with poly ICLC IM every 2 weeks for up to 3 doses in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

agents.drug_class_hint: TLR3 agonist vaccine adjuvant (stabilized polyinosinic-polycytidylic acid)

source_quote.quote: TIL quantification including tumor quantification of PD-1, PD-L1, CD3, CD4, CD8, Iba-I, Ki-67 measured by immunohistochemistry of FFPE tissue

coder_notes: Placebo Administration (Other) is not an active agent and is not listed. Poly ICLC and the DC vaccine are given in both groups; pembrolizumab is the randomised question. PD-L1 is only an exploratory IHC readout, not an entry requirement, so it does not affect the primary biomarker outcome. Industry collaborators (Merck Sharp & Dohme, Oncovir) are named in the sponsor field.
